B: actual recorded paper/confirmed entry date; usually next official session after S
earliest_regular_stock_exit: official session after B; same-B close is a mark, not a permitted completed exit

fillable_rate.numerator: recorded fills passing the original frozen-plan, confirmation/order/fill and expiry audits
fillable_rate.denominator: all qualifying frozen entry orders in that account; unmatched/unfilled orders retained; zero/missing denominator gives UNKNOWN

Bplus1_large_loss_rate.definition: B+1 close-mark loss >=7% from recorded entry price
Bplus1_large_loss_rate.coverage: show all entry trades, available B+1 marks and unknown marks separately

Bplus1_Bplus2_net_returns: Realized only for auditable exit fills with fees; open/blocked exits reported separately with marks, no hindsight exits or zero fees.
paper_matching_rule: Must be frozen before entry, with price, quantity, slippage, expiry, queue conservatism and limit/suspension handling. Public open/touch snapshots alone do not prove a fill.
